types.description: Harmony XB4 metal fixing collar for contact/light blocks; mechanical scope with unresolved bonding interface

document.title: Harmony XB4 Metal Control and Signaling Units — Catalog
document.pages: Physical PDF p.78 (catalog p.76) Body/fixing collar row + product photo; footnote physical p.111 (mounting required, ordered separately)

modelingNotes: Catalog p.78 lists 'Body/fixing collar — For use with: Electrical block (contact or light) — Sold in lots of 10 — ZB4BZ009 — 0.038/0.084 kg/lb'. Manufacturer prints the order number without the presentation hyphen as 'ZB4BZ009'; job identity uses 'ZB4-BZ009'.

Mechanical metal collar for mounting the operator and carrying separately ordered contact/light blocks. No switching contacts or light source are included. Zero documented field-wire terminal keys in this scoped model do not assert absence of conductive attachment/bonding interfaces.
Contacts/LEDs from a complete assembly are not imported here; contact/load membership never joins nets.

The reviewed catalog does not define an electrical terminal inventory for the collar. Schneider FAQ FA284040 calls the collar fastening screw a grounding screw during XB4/ZB4 installation. Its exact electrical attachment method and installed protective continuity are not modeled, so coverage remains partial; no automatic panel bond or invented numbered PE terminal is asserted. https://www.se.com/us/en/faqs/FA284040/
No electrical rating applies to a mechanical mounting collar.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical Ø22 mm metal fixing collar / body carrier with no documented electrical terminals. It holds separately ordered contact/light blocks and clamps the operator head to the panel. Any metal-to-panel/insert bonding interface is undocumented and is modeled as zero terminals rather than an assumed bond.

MOUNT.connector: Ø22 mm panel fixing collar / operator-head body carrier
MOUNT.description: Mechanical only: clamps the XB4 operator head to a Ø22 mm panel cut-out and carries snap-in contact/light blocks (ordered separately). No electrical pins; any metal-to-panel bonding is undocumented.
